correctness.rationale: Exact Sherman–Morrison formula on the mean-zero subspace; exact potential variance and balanced-exterior penalty; all odd s excluded by an analytic derivative/second-difference split for n>=13 and direct exhaustive small cases n=3..12; even s optimized by cubic finite difference with proved strict threshold. The complete infinite-family argument does not depend on enumeration. Executed standard-library verifier passed 5868 independent rational checks, including grounded inverse resistances for small graphs.

value.rationale: A natural practical one-link design optimization on a path is solved exactly for every length, including the first non-endpoint optimum at n=10, unique optimizer, modulo-eight transition, and a 9/16 asymptotic reduction of total effective resistance. The exact location is not a routine restatement of the resistance-update identity and supplies a benchmark for one-edge graph augmentation algorithms.
